entities.summary: Boris Dlugosch is a German house music producer from Hamburg. Boris is usually known for funky/deep house tracks, mostly produced in conjunction with Mousse T. and Michi Lange, his partners in the Peppermint Jam Records label. Boris Dlugosch was a composers & musicians from Hamburg (b. 1968-08-02, Hamburg). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
